rule.name: swap_bs_collinear_merge_through_phases
rule.idea: Two-mode window rewrite on a coupled qumode pair (x,y): pushes single-wire R (phase-rotation) gates through BS beamsplitter gates using the exact conjugation identity R_x(phi) a_x^+ R_x(phi)^+ = e^{-i phi} a_x^+, which shifts the BS phase parameter p by -/+ phi; canonicalises wire order and p into [0,pi) via BS_yx(t,p)=BS_xy(t,-p) and BS_xy(t,p+pi)=BS_xy(-t,p); merges collinear BS gates sharing the same generator phase (I3); and reduces the BS angle mod 4pi using the integer-spectrum periodicity of the Schwinger generator G, replacing a 2pi BS by R(pi) on both wires. This cancels router SWAPs against adjacent hops/SWAPs on the same physical pair (e.g. SWAP_xy BS_xy(-pi,0) = R_x(-pi/2) R_y(-pi/2)), trading 2-op gates for cheaper 1-op R gates while leaving the routed wire layout untouched. Only applied when the rewrite strictly reduces the 2-op gate count.
